card.name: Space before superscript exponents and table numbers
card.fires_on: The blank space token right before a superscript-style digit, mostly the exponent in blood count units like 10 9 /L or mm 3, and also before the number after Table or Figure.

modes.label: Blood count units
modes.description: Space between 10 or mm and the exponent in neutrophil or platelet thresholds.

modes.label: Table and figure numbers
modes.description: Space or the word Table/Figure just before its number.

modes.label: Body surface area unit
modes.description: Space before the squared exponent in m2 of kidney function units.
